pid=int(pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.pid').read_text()); os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM); time.sleep(1)

base='http://localhost:3000'; maya='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'; sam='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'; manager='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'; auditor='10101010-1010-4010-8010-101010101010'
for uid,name in [(maya,'maya'),(sam,'associate'),(manager,'manager'),(auditor,'auditor')]:
 r=requests.get(base+('/api/overview' if name=='maya' else '/api/operations'),headers={'X-Demo-User':uid},timeout=8); print(name,r.status_code,list(r.json())[:6])

key='verification-persisted-ticket'; ov=requests.get(base+'/api/overview',headers={'X-Demo-User':maya}).json(); lens=next(u for u in ov['units'] if u['asset_tag']=='L-118'); body={'unit_id':lens['id'],'start_date':'2026-10-05','end_date':'2026-10-05'}; h={'X-Demo-User':maya,'Idempotency-Key':key,'Content-Type':'application/json'}
a=requests.post(base+'/api/quotes',headers=h,json=body); print('persist first',a.status_code); os.kill(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM); time.sleep(1)

print('final syntax',subprocess.run(['node','-c','public/app.js'],cwd='/app').returncode)
